items.title: Model 2 tree: constant drift shifts every node up by lambda dt
items.rule: $dr = \lambda\,dt + \sigma\,dw$; up $r + \lambda dt + \sigma\sqrt{dt}$, down $r + \lambda dt - \sigma\sqrt{dt}$; middle at date 2 is $r_0 + 2\lambda dt$
items.params_source: variant: the notes give Model 2 symbolically (l.165-169); r0 6.2%, sigma 150 bp and annual drift 0.36% are borrowed from the MR-14 f example (l.284-285)
items.teaches: Adding the same lambda dt on every branch moves the whole lattice up but keeps it recombining.

citations.note: tree shifts up by lambda dt each step; recombines
parameter values borrowed from the Vasicek example

items.title: Ho-Lee tree: a different drift each quarter, one of them negative
items.rule: $dr = \lambda_t\,dt + \sigma\,dw$; step $t$ uses its own drift: $r + \lambda_t dt \pm \sigma\sqrt{dt}$; middle at date 2 is $r_0 + (\lambda_1+\lambda_2)dt$
items.params_source: variant: the notes give the Ho-Lee tree symbolically (l.213-218) and allow negative drifts (l.229); values are illustrative. lambda_4 only places the phantom children beyond date 3
items.teaches: Time-dependent drift still recombines: the drift depends on the date, not on where the rate is.

items.title: Salomon Brothers lognormal tree: multiplicative steps
items.model: Model 4, lognormal with deterministic drift (Salomon Brothers)
items.rule: $d[\ln(r)] = a(t)\,dt + \sigma\,dw$: up $r\,e^{(a_t dt + \sigma\sqrt{dt})}$, down $r\,e^{(a_t dt - \sigma\sqrt{dt})}$; middle at date 2 is $r_0\,e^{(a_1+a_2)dt}$

param_units.a: drift of ln(r) per year, one per step (a_1..a_4)
param_units.sigma: yield volatility of ln(r) per sqrt(year)

items.params_source: variant: the notes give the tree symbolically in ln(r) and in r (l.289-311); values are illustrative. a_4 only places the phantom children beyond date 3
items.teaches: In ln(r) space the steps add, so the rate lattice multiplies and still recombines: r0 e^{(a1+a2)dt} sits in the middle.
